classification: Classically extracted geometric normal with already-known quantum residual, NOT complete classical dequantization or a new algorithm.

source_interfaces.membership: One coherent XOR bit for Tr(alpha^(k+s))=0 on the cyclic projective quotient; field/primitive alpha public, hidden normal not supplied.
source_interfaces.stronger_full_values: Full trace values reveal a linear functional with m chosen queries; this is not a membership-bit interface or automatically a quotient-periodic value sequence.
source_interfaces.stronger_white_box: A public beta=alpha^s supplies secret-correlated data; sparse membership-query lower bounds do not cover it.
not_covered: unknown group actions without public field coordinates

residual_reduction.binary_classical_extraction: Exactly m membership queries and trace-pairing linear algebra recover beta over F_2.
residual_reduction.fixed_base_field_extraction: Collect m-1 independent positive projective points; expected queries<q(m-1)+q^2/(q-1)^2; recover normal up to F_q*.
residual_reduction.residual_map: gamma=alpha^(q-1), w=normal^(q-1), gamma^s=w in order-v finite-field subgroup.
residual_reduction.known_quantum_solver: Shor discrete logarithm; bounded table phase cancellation is not a new mechanism.
residual_reduction.known_classical_solver: Kleinjung-Wesolowski Theorem1.1: expected (p*n)^(2 log2(n)+O(1)); quasi-polynomial in fixed characteristic. Statement checked, algorithm not implemented here; geometry extraction costs remain charged.
residual_reduction.classical_remaining_problem: Large discrete logarithms are not computed and not declared easy.
residual_reduction.setup_debt: Primitive-element/field representation and certificate generation must be accounted for; bounded producer factorization is not certified polynomial classical setup.

local_screens.sparse_queries: Uniform hidden shift, secret-independent initial memory and T membership queries imply mean recovery<=(1/sqrt(v)+2T sqrt(k/v))^2, capped1; arbitrary known adaptive processing allowed.
local_screens.offsets: Any injective r-bit membership tuple needs r>=ceil((v-1)/k); for growing-q Singer projective planes this is q, not logarithmic.
local_screens.random_offset_sufficiency: A charged O(log(v)/influence) tuple suffices, where influence=2(k-lambda)/v; no constant influence in the sparse regime.
local_screens.spectral_normalization: Retain zero-character amplitude and full final probabilities. Leading term4(k-lambda)/v can exceed1 and is not exact success.
local_screens.phase_cost: Almost-flat magnitude is not an efficient coherent phase compiler.

proof_obligations.PO-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW: Review the trace-normal extraction, quotient residual, reference-prefix hybrid/Minkowski proof and deterministic offset counting.
proof_obligations.PO-ACCESS: Specify bits versus full values versus supplied normal/program; charge every packed underlying query and secret-dependent side resource.
proof_obligations.PO-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY: Classify what remains after classical feature extraction and compare to known quantum solvers before admitting a new candidate.
proof_obligations.PO-PHASE-COMPILER: Give a uniform coherent phase recipe, cleanup, precision and total runtime rather than using a dense Fourier table.
proof_obligations.PO-NATURAL-REDUCTION: Connect any escape to a consequential natural problem; do not assume generic lattice reductions land in the Singer family.
proof_obligations.PO-ERROR: Include total implementation trace error and sampling-budget failures; ideal bounds and successful pilot seeds do not certify physical/asymptotic success.
proof_obligations.PO-SETUP: Account for public primitive certification and field representation costs; serialized large exponents must not lose precision.
